title: Unattributed CPU gap (external thread preemption / OS stall)
fix_rationale: Large unaccounted gaps where no Unreal engine scopes are active typically indicate operating system context switching, antivirus file scanning, disk paging, or background process contention.
evidence_template: The GameThread spent {ms} ms with no active profiled Unreal scopes ({share}% of extra frame time).

fixes.text: Add your project root and Unreal Engine directories to Windows Defender / Antivirus exclusions.
Set Windows Power Plan to 'High Performance' to prevent CPU core clock throttling or core parking.
Close resource-heavy background applications, web browsers, and recording software.

verify: Re-capture a trace and check if unaccounted timing gaps on the GameThread disappear.
caveats: This represents time spent outside Unreal Engine code execution (OS scheduling, paging, or hardware interrupts).
